entries.meaningZh: 阿尔戈多内斯〔美国地名〕
entries.en: The traveller wrote Algodones on the back of her unfinished postcard.
entries.zh: 旅人把阿尔戈多内斯写在了那张尚未写完的明信片背面。

entries.en: Our imagined journey begins in Algona with a borrowed suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们设想的旅程从阿尔戈纳开始，随身带着一个借来的行李箱。

entries.en: Algy offered to carry the awkward package upstairs.
entries.zh: 阿尔吉主动提出把那个难搬的包裹拿到楼上。

entries.en: Alhadeff reread the invitation before deciding what to wear.
entries.zh: 阿尔哈德夫重读了邀请函，才决定穿什么。

entries.en: The story ends with its narrator in Alianza, waiting for a letter.
entries.zh: 故事结束时，叙述者留在阿利安萨，等着一封信。

entries.en: She traced the name Aliceville on the faded family map.
entries.zh: 她在褪色的家族地图上描了描艾丽斯维尔这个地名。

entries.en: Alik put a bookmark beside the paragraph he wanted to discuss.
entries.zh: 亚历克在想讨论的那段文字旁夹了张书签。

entries.en: Alinder brought extra pencils for anyone who had forgotten theirs.
entries.zh: 阿林德多带了一些铅笔，供忘带的人使用。

entries.en: In the invented scene, Alinsky pauses before opening the wooden box.
entries.zh: 在这个虚构场景中，阿林斯基停了一下，才打开木盒。

entries.en: Alioto checked the measurements while the others held the shelf steady.
entries.zh: 其他人扶稳搁板时，阿利奥托核对了尺寸。

entries.en: Alisha saved the last piece of cake for her paternal grandmother.
entries.zh: 阿莉莎把最后一块蛋糕留给了祖母。

entries.en: Alivia moved her chair so that everyone could see the screen.
entries.zh: 阿利维娅挪了挪椅子，让每个人都能看见屏幕。

entries.en: Alixe preferred the rough sketch to the polished final version.
entries.zh: 比起精修的最终版本，阿利克斯更喜欢那幅草图。

entries.en: The student circled Alkaid on her printed star chart.
entries.zh: 学生在打印的星图上圈出了摇光。

entries.en: A photograph labelled Alken fell from the old travel diary.
entries.zh: 一张标着阿尔肯的照片从旧旅行日记里掉了出来。

entries.en: Alkire held the ladder while his neighbour reached the loose gutter.
entries.zh: 邻居伸手去够松动的檐沟时，阿尔基尔扶住了梯子。

entries.en: The fictional traveller hopes to reach Allada before her birthday.
entries.zh: 故事里的旅人希望在生日前到达阿拉达。

entries.en: We found Allagash mentioned on three pages of the family diary.
entries.zh: 我们发现，家族日记中有三页提到了阿勒加什。

entries.en: Allaire turned the music down when the conversation became serious.
entries.zh: 谈话变得严肃起来时，阿莱尔调低了音乐音量。

entries.en: Allam volunteered to explain the rules to the newcomers.
entries.zh: 奥勒姆自愿向新来的人解释规则。

entries.en: The narrator keeps a postcard from Alland beside her unfinished manuscript.
entries.zh: 叙述者在未完成的手稿旁放着一张来自阿兰的明信片。

entries.en: Allaway noticed that two pages had been stapled in the wrong order.
entries.zh: 阿拉韦发现，有两页被按错误的顺序订在了一起。

entries.en: Allchin wrapped the cracked bowl before placing it in the box.
entries.zh: 奥尔欣先包好裂了的碗，再把它放进箱子里。

entries.en: Alldredge waited until the room was quiet before telling the story.
entries.zh: 奥尔德雷奇等到房间里安静下来才开始讲故事。

entries.en: Alldridge left a handwritten reminder beside the empty fruit bowl.
entries.zh: 奥尔德里奇在空果盘旁留了一张手写提醒。

entries.en: Allegretti suggested moving the rehearsal to a smaller room.
entries.zh: 阿莱格雷蒂建议把排练改到一间小些的房间进行。

entries.en: Allemann compared the two receipts and spotted the missing item.
entries.zh: 阿勒曼对照了两张收据，找出了漏掉的那一项。

entries.en: Their imaginary reunion in Allenhurst occupies the novel's opening chapter.
entries.zh: 他们在艾伦赫斯特的虚构重聚，是小说开篇一章的内容。

entries.en: Allenson carried the spare chairs back after the discussion ended.
entries.zh: 讨论结束后，艾伦森把备用椅子搬了回去。

entries.meaningZh: 阿伦施泰因〔奥尔什丁的旧称〕
entries.en: The archivist kept the name Allenstein when transcribing the historical letter.
entries.zh: 档案员誊写那封历史信件时，保留了阿伦施泰因这个旧地名。

entries.en: A letter sent from Allensworth supplied the missing clue in the story.
entries.zh: 故事中，一封从艾伦斯沃思寄出的信提供了缺失的线索。

entries.en: Her fictional character returns to Allenton with a suitcase full of notebooks.
entries.zh: 她笔下的虚构人物带着满满一箱笔记本回到了艾伦顿。

entries.en: The envelope bore an Allenwood address but contained no letter.
entries.zh: 信封上写着艾伦伍德的地址，里面却没有信。

entries.en: Allgeier asked for a clearer explanation of the final diagram.
entries.zh: 奥尔盖耶要求把最后那幅图解释得更清楚些。

entries.en: Allingham folded the spare blanket over the back of the sofa.
entries.zh: 阿林厄姆把备用毯子折好，搭在了沙发靠背上。

entries.en: In the story, a forgotten visit to Allington connects the two families.
entries.zh: 故事中，一次被遗忘的阿灵顿之行把两个家庭联系起来了。

entries.en: Allister practised his introduction until he could say it without notes.
entries.zh: 阿利斯特反复练习开场介绍，直到不用看笔记也能说出来。

entries.en: Allitt returned the borrowed coat with a neatly repaired pocket.
entries.zh: 阿利特归还了借来的外套，口袋已经补得整整齐齐。

entries.en: Allmendinger stepped aside to let the delivery driver through.
entries.zh: 奥尔门丁格让到一旁，让送货司机过去。

entries.en: Allnutt found the missing button beneath the sewing basket.
entries.zh: 奥尔纳特在针线篮下面找到了丢失的纽扣。

entries.en: The novel ends with an unsent letter addressed to someone in Allora.
entries.zh: 小说以一封未寄出的信结束，收信人住在阿洛拉。

entries.en: Allott drew a quick plan before rearranging the crowded workshop.
entries.zh: 阿洛特先画了一张简图，再重新布置拥挤的工作间。

entries.en: Allouez offered a gentler way to phrase the difficult question.
entries.zh: 阿卢埃提出，可以用一种更温和的说法来问那个棘手问题。

entries.en: A postcard from Alloway slipped out of the family album.
entries.zh: 一张来自阿洛韦的明信片从家庭相册里滑了出来。

entries.en: Allport checked that every participant had received a copy of the agenda.
entries.zh: 奥尔波特确认每位参与者都收到了一份议程。

entries.en: Allsop put the fragile parcel where nobody would trip over it.
entries.zh: 奥尔索普把易碎包裹放到了不会绊倒人的地方。

entries.en: Allsopp added a quieter passage between the two lively musical sections.
entries.zh: 奥尔索普在两个活泼的乐段之间加入了一段更安静的音乐。

entries.en: Allvine remembered the tune but could not recall its title.
entries.zh: 奥尔文记得曲调，却想不起曲名。

entries.en: Allyson took the smaller desk so her roommate could keep the larger one.
entries.zh: 阿莉森用了较小的书桌，让室友留下较大的那张。

entries.en: The class compared two reproductions of paintings by Alma-Tadema.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两幅阿尔马·塔德玛画作的复制品。

entries.en: Almack checked the cupboard before adding flour to the shopping list.
entries.zh: 奥尔马克先检查了橱柜，才把面粉添到购物清单上。

entries.en: Almaguer offered to read the difficult passage aloud.
entries.zh: 阿尔马格主动提出把那段难懂的文字读出来。

entries.en: Almasi copied the corrected figure onto a fresh sheet of paper.
entries.zh: 阿尔马希把修正后的数字抄到了一张新纸上。

entries.en: The imagined traveller keeps her letters from Almeda in a blue folder.
entries.zh: 设想中的旅人把来自阿尔梅达的信放在蓝色文件夹里。

entries.en: Almgren listened to both suggestions before proposing a compromise.
entries.zh: 阿尔姆格伦听完两个建议，才提出折中方案。

entries.en: Almira stayed behind to help fold the patterned stage curtain.
entries.zh: 阿尔迈拉留了下来，帮忙折叠绘有图案的舞台幕布。

entries.en: The storyteller describes leaving Almont with more questions than answers.
entries.zh: 讲故事的人描述了离开阿尔蒙特时疑问比答案还多的情形。

entries.en: Almquist repaired the loose handle rather than replacing the entire drawer.
entries.zh: 阿尔姆奎斯特修好了松动的把手，没有更换整个抽屉。

entries.en: The teacher pointed to Alnilam in the illustrated sky guide.
entries.zh: 老师指向了配有插图的观星指南中的参宿二。

entries.en: Alonzo kept a spare umbrella beside the door for unexpected visitors.
entries.zh: 阿朗佐在门旁放了一把备用伞，供突然来访的人使用。

entries.en: A pencilled question mark stood beside Alota in the fictional travel plan.
entries.zh: 那份虚构旅行计划中，阿洛塔旁边有个铅笔写的问号。

entries.en: The photographer placed her Alpa camera on a padded table.
entries.zh: 摄影师把自己的阿尔帕相机放在了铺有软垫的桌上。

entries.en: A fictional postcard from Alpaugh begins with an apology for the delay in writing.
entries.zh: 一张来自阿尔波的虚构明信片，开头便为迟迟没写信而道歉。

entries.en: The narrator imagines meeting her oldest friend again in Alpena.
entries.zh: 叙述者想象着在阿尔皮纳再次见到自己相识最久的朋友。

entries.en: Alperin balanced the tray while someone cleared a space on the table.
entries.zh: 有人腾出桌上空间时，阿尔珀林稳稳地端着托盘。

entries.en: Alpern replaced the torn paper cover without disturbing the notebook's contents.
entries.zh: 阿尔珀恩换掉了破损的纸封皮，没有弄乱笔记本里的内容。

entries.en: Alperovitz sorted the donated books into fiction, history, and science.
entries.zh: 阿尔佩罗维茨把捐来的书分成了小说、历史和科学三类。

entries.en: We looked up Alphard in the star chart's alphabetical index.
entries.zh: 我们在星图的字母索引中查了星宿一。

entries.en: Alphege chose a seat where the afternoon light would reach his book.
entries.zh: 阿尔菲奇选了个座位，下午的阳光可以照到他读的书。

entries.en: The unfinished story leaves two friends arguing about their visit to Alphen.
entries.zh: 那个未完成的故事中，两个朋友还在争论他们的阿尔芬之行。

entries.en: Alpher wiped the muddy footprints away before the floor dried.
entries.zh: 地板还没干时，阿尔弗就把泥脚印擦掉了。

entries.en: Alphonzo divided the long rehearsal into three shorter sessions.
entries.zh: 阿方索把那次长时间排练分成了三个较短的时段。

entries.en: The student found Alsace-Lorraine mentioned repeatedly in the historical letters.
entries.zh: 学生发现，那些历史信件多次提到了阿尔萨斯-洛林。

entries.en: Alsberg checked the parcel's address before sealing the box.
entries.zh: 阿尔斯伯格核对了包裹地址，才把箱子封好。

entries.en: She added Alsea to the list of places her fictional narrator remembers.
entries.zh: 她把阿尔西厄添到了虚构叙述者记得的地方清单中。

entries.en: The class used a tracing of the Alsek to practise reading river maps.
entries.zh: 全班用一张描摹阿尔塞克河的图练习读河流地图。

entries.en: Alsobrook rescued the handwritten recipe from a pile of discarded envelopes.
entries.zh: 奥索布鲁克从一堆废弃信封中取出了那张手写食谱。

entries.en: Alstadt turned the photograph over and found a date in pencil.
entries.zh: 阿尔斯塔特把照片翻过来，发现背面用铅笔写着一个日期。

entries.en: Alsup offered to walk the nervous visitor to the meeting room.
entries.zh: 阿尔苏普主动提出陪那位紧张的访客走到会议室。

entries.en: Altabe asked the group to explain the joke rather than repeat it louder.
entries.zh: 阿尔塔贝请大家解释那个笑话，而不是更大声地重复一遍。

entries.en: The fictional visitor writes about Altadena in a letter to her cousin.
entries.zh: 那位虚构访客在给堂表亲的信中写到了阿尔塔迪纳。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔塔格拉西亚〔委内瑞拉地名〕
entries.en: The writer chose Altagracia as the destination of an imaginary homecoming.
entries.zh: 作者把阿尔塔格拉西亚设为一次虚构返乡之旅的目的地。

entries.en: The sketch she made of the Altamaha was folded inside the geography notebook.
entries.zh: 她画的奥尔塔马霍河草图折起来夹在了地理笔记本里。

entries.en: A postcard marked Altamirano prompted the narrator to reconsider the old itinerary.
entries.zh: 一张标着阿尔塔米拉诺的明信片，让叙述者重新思考起从前的行程。

entries.en: Altamont returned the misdelivered package without opening it.
entries.zh: 阿尔塔芒特没有打开那个送错的包裹，直接把它退回了。

entries.en: Altbach drew a small arrow beside the paragraph that needed rewriting.
entries.zh: 阿尔特巴克在需要重写的段落旁画了一个小箭头。

entries.en: The story's narrator hopes to send her next letter from Altenberg.
entries.zh: 故事的叙述者希望从阿尔滕贝格寄出下一封信。

entries.en: An old photograph of Altenburg helped the fictional traveller plan her visit.
entries.zh: 一张阿尔滕堡的旧照片，帮助那位虚构旅人计划了行程。

entries.en: Alterman adjusted the lamp until the tiny print was easier to read.
entries.zh: 奥尔特曼调整了灯，让那些小字更容易辨认。

entries.en: Altermann obtained permission before photographing the unfinished mural.
entries.zh: 奥尔特曼先征得许可，才拍摄那幅尚未完成的壁画。

entries.en: The novel's opening letter comes from Altha and has no return address.
entries.zh: 小说开头的信来自奥尔萨，没有写寄信人的回信地址。

entries.en: Althoff let the last visitor finish speaking before closing the discussion.
entries.zh: 奥尔索夫等最后一位访客把话说完，才结束讨论。

entries.en: Altizer attached the missing page before returning the borrowed manuscript.
entries.zh: 奥尔蒂泽补上缺失的那一页，才归还借来的手稿。

entries.en: Altobelli carried the sleeping cat away from the freshly painted bench.
entries.zh: 阿尔托贝利把熟睡的猫从刚刷过漆的长凳那儿抱走了。

entries.en: Altrock chose a simple tune that everyone could learn quickly.
entries.zh: 阿尔特罗克选了一首大家都能很快学会的简单曲子。

entries.en: Altschul counted the spare blankets before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来前，阿特休尔数了数备用毯子。

entries.en: Altshuler waited for the glue to dry before putting the picture frame back.
entries.zh: 阿特舒勒等胶水干了，才把相框放回原处。

entries.en: A mention of Altuna interrupts the fictional narrator's account of the journey.
entries.zh: 虚构叙述者讲述旅程时，中间插入了对阿尔图纳的提及。

entries.en: The fictional family debates whether to spend another night in Alturas.
entries.zh: 故事中的一家人争论着要不要在阿尔图拉斯再住一晚。

entries.en: Alutto repaired the torn lining before returning the coat to its owner.
entries.zh: 阿卢托补好了撕裂的衬里，才把外套还给物主。

entries.en: Alvary kept the discussion focused on the question everyone had agreed to answer.
entries.zh: 阿尔瓦里让讨论始终围绕大家同意回答的那个问题展开。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔韦阿尔〔阿根廷地名〕
entries.en: The narrator marks Alvear on the map before reconsidering her imagined journey.
entries.zh: 叙述者先在地图上标出阿尔韦阿尔，再重新考虑她设想的旅程。

entries.en: Alverson left the library book open beside a half-finished cup of tea.
entries.zh: 阿尔弗森把那本图书馆的书摊在一杯喝了一半的茶旁。

entries.en: The fictional traveller describes her stay at Alvie without naming the other guests.
entries.zh: 那位虚构旅人描述了在阿尔维停留的经历，却没有提到其他客人的名字。

entries.en: Alvis offered the tired visitor a chair near the window.
entries.zh: 阿尔维斯请疲惫的访客坐在靠窗的一把椅子上。

entries.en: The story's first postcard from Alviso contains more questions than news.
entries.zh: 故事中，第一张来自阿尔维索的明信片写的问题比近况还多。

entries.en: She placed the photograph labelled Alvor beside the unfinished travel diary.
entries.zh: 她把标着阿尔沃尔的照片放在了尚未写完的旅行日记旁。

entries.en: Alvy shortened the invitation so that it would fit on one card.
entries.zh: 阿尔维缩短了邀请函的文字，好让它能写在一张卡片上。

entries.en: Alworth made room on the shelf for the newly donated dictionaries.
entries.zh: 奥尔沃思在架子上腾出空间，放新捐来的词典。

entries.en: Alyce returned the empty basket with a handwritten note of thanks.
entries.zh: 艾丽斯归还空篮子时，附上了一张手写感谢便条。

entries.en: Alycia practised the unfamiliar rhythm by tapping gently on the table.
entries.zh: 阿莉西娅轻轻敲着桌子，练习那段不熟悉的节奏。

entries.en: Alyea separated the wet sketches so they would not stick together.
entries.zh: 阿利亚把还湿着的速写分开，以免它们粘在一起。

entries.en: Alys remembered to bring the spare key but forgot the shopping list.
entries.zh: 艾丽斯记得带备用钥匙，却忘了购物清单。

entries.en: Alysha explained the change of plan before anyone started packing.
entries.zh: 大家还没开始收拾行李，阿莉莎就解释了计划的变化。

entries.en: Alzado put the repaired chair aside for its owner to collect.
entries.zh: 阿尔萨多把修好的椅子放到一旁，等物主来取。

entries.en: Amabile checked the final paragraph for anything that might sound unkind.
entries.zh: 阿马比尔检查了最后一段，看看有没有听起来不友善的措辞。

entries.en: Amacher brought a larger bowl when the mixture began to overflow.
entries.zh: 混合物开始溢出时，阿马彻拿来了一个更大的碗。

entries.en: Amacker compared the two sketches without knowing which artist had drawn each one.
entries.zh: 阿马克比较了两幅速写，并不知道它们分别出自哪位画家。

entries.en: The reading group discussed Amado without revealing the ending of the novel.
entries.zh: 读书小组讨论了阿玛多，但没有透露小说的结局。

entries.en: The fictional visitor plans to meet her friend on Amager.
entries.zh: 那位虚构访客打算在阿迈厄岛与朋友见面。
